description.zh:
是否全部删除资源的标签，只针对`TagKey.N`为空时有效。取值范围：

- true
 
- false
 
默认：false
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resources. This parameter takes effect only when `TagKey.N` is empty. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default: false
The type of the resource. The value must be \`instance\`.

description.zh: 要删除的资源的标签键列表。
description.en: A list of tag keys to remove.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt untag-resources --tag-key tagkeyTest --resource-id mqtt-cn-5yd3xxx --resource-type instance --all false --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'mqtt-cn-5yd3xxx' --TagKey.1 tagkeyTest --ResourceType instance
